fellowship.projectTitle: Human–AI Interaction for Health and Well-being Among Vulnerable User Populations
fellowship.projectAbstract: Potential research themes include: 1) how AI explanations and feedback influence user trust, anxiety, or self-efficacy in healthrelated decision-making; 2) how interaction design can support accessibility and autonomy for users with visual impairments or other sensory or cognitive challenges; 3) how AI-mediated interventions shape users’ awareness, self-regulation, and coping strategies in contexts such as stress management or addiction recovery.
